lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is widest between the first three anterior lines and narrows progressively towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed where the 2nd and 3rd anterior lines merge at the ventral boundary; a minor Y-shaped split is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 10th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 9, 10, and 11 terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral edge, while line 12 is represented by a series of fragmented dots.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch, situated between the posterior torso lines and the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of four spots on the lower flank forming a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the ventral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the orbital regions; white patch on the throat; white spots on the posterior of the hind legs and anterior of the forelegs; white-tipped bushy tail.
